summary: Iteration 11 — full backend + frontend validation of the CLM v2 changes (counterparty optional, PATCH/DELETE contract, seed disabled, dev-login 410, AI OCR). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passing (test_iteration_11_changes.py) including admin login, dashboard, POST /api/contracts without counterparty, POST with full fields (provider/product/payment_breakdown), PATCH updates (title/total_value/provider) with consultant mirroring provider and retention_value=total_value*0.05 recalculated and a 'contract updated' timeline entry appended, 403 on PATCH by non-owner user, DELETE returns {ok:true, deleted:<id>} and subsequent GET 404, POST /api/seed anonymous → 401, POST /api/seed as admin → 200 with {ok:false, disabled:true}, POST /api/auth/dev-login → 410 Gone, POST /api/ai/extract-contract on a text PDF (PyMuPDF built) → 200 with title+total_value parsed, and OCR fallback via Claude vision on a scanned/image-only PDF → 200 with structured JSON. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667, Playwright): login as admin → dashboard; navigation to /contracts (testid contracts-screen visible); tap new-contract-button → /contract/new; VERIFIED the contract-counterparty-input testID DOES NOT exist on the new form (regression); filled title/provider/value/signed → submit → routed to /contract/{id} where contract-detail-screen, edit-contract-button, delete-contract-button, and download-print-button are all present; tapped edit → /contract/{id}/edit with title pre-filled ('Contrato Playwright'); changed title to 'Contrato Playwright EDITADO' and submitted → returned to detail page showing new title; tapped delete → confirmation modal appears with delete-confirm button; confirmed delete → routed back to /contracts and the deleted contract is no longer present. All 12 request items are green. Only pre-existing non-blocking RN warnings observed (shadow* deprecated, props.pointerEvents deprecated).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Not blocking. Reference: multiple StyleSheet.create usages across app/ (theme.ts shadow tokens).

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking; likely from a third-party wrapper (react-native-modal / RN internal). Reference: React Native / library internals.
